summary: Example generator config producing hosts like build_web_dev_runner from operation, environment and application layers with nested parent groups; enable the plugin in ansible.cfg and view with ansible-inventory --list.
questions: How do I preview hosts created by the generator plugin?
Do I need to enable the generator plugin?
What's an example generator inventory config?

answer_card.title: generator inventory example
answer_card.answer_md:
Enable the plugin in `ansible.cfg`, then check output with `ansible-inventory -i inventory.config --list`.

```yaml
plugin: ansible.builtin.generator
hosts:
  name: "{{ operation }}_{{ application }}_{{ environment }}_runner"
  parents:
    - name: "{{ operation }}_{{ application }}_{{ environment }}"
      parents:
        - name: "{{ operation }}_{{ application }}"
          parents:
            - name: "{{ operation }}"
            - name: "{{ application }}"
        - name: "{{ application }}_{{ environment }}"
          parents:
            - name: "{{ application }}"
              vars:
                application: "{{ application }}"
            - name: "{{ environment }}"
              vars:
                environment: "{{ environment }}"
    - name: runner
layers:
  operation: [build, launch]
  environment: [dev, test, prod]
  application: [web, api]
```
